newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah little changed in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah little changed in late trading.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah was little changed against the dollar in dull late trading on Monday, with sentiment seen remaining firm on the rupiah, dealers said.
One Japanese bank dealer said pressure on the U.S. currency remained despite sustained ample liquidity in the money market.
He said operators would like to go long on dollars because of prevailing cheap swap rates, but fears over a possible band widening prevented broad dollars buying.
"The profit is clearly there if people dare to go long on dollars. Roll-over costs are pretty cheap," the dealer said.
Overnight swap was at 0.15/0.25 and tom/next at 0.23/0.28.
But there was still speculation in the market that the central bank might widen its band again, dealers said.
The central bank did not response to market speculation and depreciated the rupiah by another point on Monday although the dollar-rupiah rate was trading at its lower band.
Bank Indonesia raised its intervention rate by one point to 2,362/2,554 and the conversion rate to 2,362/2,410.
Dealers said the market seemed to shrug off the 1997/78 budget which was unveiled on Monday morning.
They said the focus now was the band although some concerns were seen on a widening of the current account deficit.

Andrew Fung, regional treasury economist at Standard Chartered Bank in Singapore, said the budget was likely to support investor confidence in Indonesia as it showed the government was maintaining responsible policies.
But he said it would have little impact on the rupiah since forex markets were mainly focused on the band.
One U.S. bank dealer said operators kept selling swaps which pushed them to a level where many operators believed they have been oversold.
However, pressure was still there because of the ample rupiah supply, dealers said.
One-month swap was at 12.00/12.75, two at 23.00/24.00, three at 35.00/36.00 and six at 75.0/75.5 points.
Spot rupiah was at 2,362.0/62.1 at 0920 GMT against an opening of 2,361.80/62.80. Tomorrow and today rupiah closed at 2,361.60/61.90 and 2,361.25/61.75, respectively.
